annotation.title_clean: State of the Digital Decade 2025: Keep building the EU's sovereignty and digital future
annotation.title_en: State of the Digital Decade 2025: Keep building the EU's sovereignty and digital future
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Communication assessing progress at the midpoint of the EU Digital Decade 2030 policy programme. It reviews targets, investment gaps, digital dependencies and defence applications, with AI as one theme. Embodied AI appears only in passing (autonomous vehicles); it recommends sovereignty, investment and Member State coordination.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU progress toward Digital Decade targets is uneven, with AI, cloud and digital skills far behind.
Digital investment gap estimated at about EUR 150 billion per year, requiring more private capital.
Excessive dependencies on foreign semiconductors, cloud and cybersecurity threaten technological sovereignty.
Digital technologies including AI and dual-use innovation should be integrated into EU defence capacity.
Commission will review the Digital Decade Policy Programme by June 2026.
